verdict.rationale: The UK IPO runs account-based digital services for patents and trade marks, so bulk data export is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence only documents getting copies of individual patent, trade mark or design documents and surrendering registrations. Those are related features, not a documented way to export all of a user's data in open formats. Nothing in the pack shows bulk export, machine-readable formats or account data portability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
